description:
Files:
- existing JidoChatBridge admission boundary
- existing Engine history/routing and replay owners, to verify before coding

Functional specifications:
Update existing zaq-zho, do not duplicate it. Enforce sync_history=false and sync_full_history=false at every initial/reconnect connection. No initial import-enable control. Unexpected history_sync batches must not persist or trigger agent replies. Verify and extend persistent connector+peer+message scoped deduplication, preserving accepted-message retry safety. Offline queued messages are separate from history sync: establish upstream origin metadata and obtain a deliberate catchup policy before finalizing that path; do not infer history solely from arrival time or silently drop legitimate queued messages. Respect configured chat/routing scope.

Tests before implementation:
- No historical download/import/reply on pairing or reconnect
- Unexpected history batch filtered
- Duplicates within/across accounts and rooms
- Replay after restart
- Mixed queued/live batches
- Selected/unselected chats
- Property tests for admission identity

Branches validated:
- first pairing
- reconnect
- offline catchup
- duplicate
- retry
- uncertain origin
- disabled connector

Documentation:
- docs/services/channels.md
- operator history/catchup explanation
- record final catchup decision in zaq-zho

Action reuse assessment:
Reuse Amarula sync flags, current Channels sink and Engine capture/routing/replay operations. Inspect existing dedupe ownership before extending, no parallel store by default. Trusted event in, admitted message or filtered reason out; side effects only after admission. No new agent Action.

Validation:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md validation lifecycle; tests before implementation, focused checks per issue, final gate before approval. No live account connection or send without scoped authorization.

Mocking:
External Amarula transport only; use real internal boundaries and isolated DB/process/storage fixtures; inject config and clock without global mutation.

Policy:
Recheck module responsibilities, docs/services/channels.md, Action reuse, system-config and testing guidance before coding. BO calls use explicit NodeRouter Events; nil actor never grants permission.

comments.text: History sync false flags already enforced in shared Config on all starts; provider policy now drops unexpected history_sync before decoder. Reused persistent Engine source identity/admission instead of parallel dedupe. Added DB replay test across fresh callers, rooms and accounts, real decoder filter test preserves ordinary queued message. Catchup default: process ordinary queued events normally, dedupe persistently. Amarula emits same messages_upsert shape for queued/live and adapter drops arrival provenance; no reliable separate capture-only policy without upstream changes. User asked asynchronously; no contrary reply received. mix q and 60 tests/4 properties pass.

title: [zaq-zho] Disable history sync and control reconnect admission
